title: Aston Machan Doll Totem
description: Replaces Totem of Undying with Aston Machan Doll
body:
## Replace Totem of Undying with Aston Machan Doll!

- Rename your totem to Machan Doll or Machan Doll Valentine
- Or replace all totem's with Machan Dolls
- With custom sound!

### This resoucepack comes in 2 different versions
[Rename version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/aston-machan-doll-totem-(rename)) replaces Totem of Undying if it is renamed to Machan Doll\Machan Doll Valentine.

Every totem version replaces all Totems of Undying with Machan Doll.

![Umazing!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e358d3ca1bcd5773fd04219d225ae9e2844f72d1.png)
